FIELDS.NAME: Happy Bites Family Restaurant
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Happy Bites Family Restaurant operates as a family-friendly establishment focused on providing a diverse menu that caters to guests of all ages. With a commitment to quality, we prepare our meals using fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Our restaurant is designed to accommodate a seating capacity of no more than 150 guests, ensuring a comfortable dining experience while maintaining manageable crowd dynamics.

We specialize in quick service, offering counter ordering with efficient meal preparation that minimizes wait times. Our operations prioritize health and safety, with a strong emphasis on food safety training for all staff and compliance with local health codes. We conduct regular maintenance on kitchen equipment and fire suppression systems to mitigate any operational risks.

Additionally, we limit our sales of alcoholic beverages to beer and wine, ensuring that they do not exceed 25% of total sales, thus minimizing our liquor liability exposure. Happy Bites is dedicated to creating a welcoming atmosphere while adhering to industry standards for safety and cleanliness, making us a reliable choice for families seeking a pleasurable dining experience.
